title: Rhipsalis Baccifera - Mistletoe Cactus - 1x Plug Plant - Easy Care Succulent
description:
Rhipsalis baccifera, commonly known as mistletoe cactus, is an epiphytic cactus with slender, trailing, cylindrical stems in green to pale blue-green tones. Young segments may show sparse woolly areoles with a few bristly spines that often disappear as the stems mature. Small, funnel-shaped white to greenish-white flowers can appear along the stems, typically winter to spring, and may occur intermittently year-round. These are followed by small, round, translucent white to pale pink berries.


 Key Features:


  Type: Epiphytic, evergreen cactus; trailing habit
 

  Synonym: Rhipsalis cassytha
 

  Family: Cactaceae
 

  Mature size: Height 2.5–4 m (with long, trailing stems); spread 0.5–1 m
 

  Growth rate: Reaches ultimate size in approximately 5–10 years
 

  Flowers: Small, white to greenish-white, funnel-shaped
 

  Fruit: Small translucent white to pale pink berries (non-edible; for ornamental purposes)
 

  Hardiness rating: H1B (UK scale) – suitable under glass/indoors; can be placed outdoors in warm summers (10–15°C), protect from cold
 

  Position: Bright, indirect light; tolerates full sun or partial shade if acclimated
 

  Aspect: East-, South-, or West-facing; sheltered exposure
 

  Foliage: Evergreen
 

  Native range: Tropics
 

 Care Instructions:


  Growing medium: Use a free-draining epiphytic cactus mix
 

  Watering: Water moderately during active growth; keep just moist in winter
 

  Humidity: Prefers high humidity; mist with soft water if indoor air is dry
 

  Feeding: Apply a dilute, low-nitrogen fertilizer monthly during the growing season
 

  Pruning: Not required; long stems can be trimmed to manage length
 

  Pests: May be susceptible to mealybugs
 

  Diseases: Generally disease-free
 

 Propagation:


  By seed (19–24°C)
 

  By stem cuttings in spring or summer
 

 Suggested Uses:


  Hanging baskets
 

  Houseplant displays
 

  Conservatory or greenhouse
 

 What You Will Receive:


  One Rhipsalis baccifera plant (mistletoe cactus).
 

  Notes:
 

   Non-hardy outdoors in cold climates. Avoid frost.
  

   Berries are ornamental and not intended for consumption.
  

   Plant appearance may vary slightly due to natural variation.
